summary: feat(settings): add Synced data row and delete Sync data flow
description:
Because:
- Users need to delete their Sync data from Settings once per-engine toggles in Firefox stop deleting server data.
- Security review SA-1022 requires the MFA guard plus a password check before the delete.

This commit:
- Add a "Synced data" row to Data Collection and Use that links to the new flow.
- Add /settings/delete_sync_data behind an MFA guard: confirm password, then pick devices to sign out, one row per device name as in Connected Services.
- Gate the row and route on featureFlags.syncDataDeletionEnabled; the route also requires a password.
- Map isSyncCapable onto the Settings attached client model.
- Add stories per step and unit tests for both steps and the device grouping.

Relates to FXA-14895
